basic_profile.bio: I'm a 30-year-old gamer from upstate New York who's diving back into the world of competitive gaming after a long hiatus. During the day, I work as a software developer at a small tech startup. In the evenings, you'll find me grinding ranks in League of Legends or exploring new gaming strategies. I recently moved to New York, so I'm also exploring the local cannabis scene. I'm single and enjoy spending my weekends hiking or visiting local coffee shops to relax and unwind.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies primarily in software development, having pursued a degree in Computer Science and working in the tech industry for over 8 years. Gaming has been a lifelong passion, and my current focus is on mastering League of Legends, particularly the Kindred character. I am largely self-taught in this area, often learning through community forums, streams, and YouTube guides.
